hint.text: An adverbial word or phrase is something we use in sentences and paragraphs to improve cohesion and clarity. These words or phrases tell us how (adverbials of manner), when (adverbials of time), where (adverbials of place) or how often (adverbials of frequency) something happens.
hint.sound: An adverbial word or phrase is something we use in sentences and paragraphs to improve cohesion and clarity. These words or phrases tell us how, when, where or how often something happens.

instruction.text: Find the adverbial phrase which helps the two sentences flow better.

atoms.sound: I love being by the sea. Every year, we drive to the coast.
